notes.title: ChronoBreach Ultra Coming to Steam Summer 2020
notes.content:
ChronoBreach Ultra is the full version of ChronoBreach coming Summer 2020!

Wishlist Now on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1297800/ChronoBreach_Ultra/

New Features:
 Greater challenge: fight through enemy encounters that force you to think quickly, bend time to your will, and come up with inventive solutions
 Tons more levels: explore new environments as you uncover the secrets of this mysterious facility
 An arsenal of destructive weapons: wield a wide variety of weapons from blasters to rifles to rocket launchers to laser swords
 Unlockable skins: change your appearance by unlocking skins
 Arena Mode: take on the Arena and fight for survival to earn rewards
 An updated Speedrun Mode: hone your skills even further and conquer time entirely


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34833116/2a946191db7d9813520bd2b41f760f269432cff2.gif

Please wishlist the game to be notified when it releases! Thank you for your support!

notes.title: ChronoBreach Version 1.1 Released
notes.content:
I have released Version 1.1 of ChronoBreach.

The changes are:

 Performance improvements
 Adjusted player movement physics (more deceleration)


The adjustments in player movement make the game's controls feel a lot better. It no longer feels as slippery. Thank you for all of the feedback I have received; I hope that this update makes the game more enjoyable to play.
